description: Adds dates to booking products, such as a tour's departures.

items.description: A date of a booking product. A date the product has already is left as it is.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id of the booking product.

Date.description: The date, as yyyy-MM-dd. Give Date or DaysFromToday.

DaysFromToday.description: The date as a number of days from today, so a sample's dates stay ahead.

Time.description: The start time of a time slot, as HH:mm. Leave it out for a whole day.

Capacity.description: The places the date has. 10 when left out.

Price.description: The date's own price, or leave it out for the product's.
